identity.premise: A floating non-animal entity organized around a central core and an incomplete asymmetric orbit.

visual_contract.topology: non-grounded floating central core with orbiting structural segments
silhouette_invariants: central floating core remains visually dominant
orbit creates visible negative space around the core
orbit is incomplete/asymmetric rather than a perfect halo
identity must not collapse into a normal grounded animal silhouette

signature_features.description: An incomplete asymmetric orbital structure whose negative space is part of the body read, not decorative VFX.

material_intent: central core and orbit must read as intentionally related structures

provenance.notes: Provisional architecture test fixture derived from the Spirit experiment direction and P01 exploratory evidence. Not production canon, flagship selection, or market validation.
